programme.title: Road absurdities 6
programme.desc: You cannot turn left from the left turn lane - such inconsistent markings can be found in Warsaw, where it is also difficult not to notice sound-absorbing screens costing over PLN 600,000.PLN separating traffic lanes.Nearly 100 thousandPLN was spent on investing in pedestrian crossing signals in Osięciny - currently they are covered with black bags.Kamil and Krzysiek will also visit Podolszyn Nowy to see a wrongly placed sign informing about the traffic organization at the intersection, and in Łódź they will see non-working lamps on a forest road costing nearly PLN 150,000 and see a sign that exempts customers and suppliers from the laws of physics on a steep driveway.

programme.title: Road absurdities 6
programme.desc: Are we waiting for a dead body?" - this is the rhetorical question Kamil and Krzysiek will come across in Inowrocław, right next to something that resembles a roundabout, although it is not a roundabout at all.
